purpose: Confirm latency differences only after host stability and pilot review; not a load or mobile claim
source_policy: Freeze four full SHAs; verify app/lib contents and dependency/image hashes; no main changes

design.transport: Choose and register ASGI or TCP before collection; never pool both
design.sizing_basis: Initial affordable budget for P95 CI estimation, not guaranteed precision; use pilot autocorrelation and clustered intervals
design.primary_metric: P95 latency at concurrency one, errors and integrity reported alongside
design.precision_target_to_review: 95% paired-block CI relative half-width <=10% of baseline P95
design.stopping: Pre-register final n/blocks after stability pilot, or a sequential method with valid repeated-look control; do not stop on favorable result
design.p99: Disabled unless effective tail sample and order-statistic/block interval achieve a separately preregistered precision target
design.warmup: Pilot up to 100 requests; require three stable predeclared windows before warm measurements; otherwise classify cold/nonstationary

preconditions: No Flutter compilation, migration, mutation or other campaign on the host at the same time
Record CPU/RAM/IO background activity and Windows power/thermal conditions; dedicated window preferable
Restore schema/data/private cache identically, fix PostgreSQL image and worker counts
Measure instrumentation overhead equivalently; oracle outside timed span, validate response after measurement
Abort on OOM/restart, disk >80%, error/timeout >5% for 60 seconds or unrecovered backlog
Budget/time assessed before running; a 1000-request cell may be expensive on the observed official version
pending_implementation: Budgeted longer-sample executor and integration with stability gates
Record IO/power/thermal and establish a quiet controlled execution window
Preregister final block count, estimand, bootstrap unit and precision from a fresh stability pilot
interpretation: The current critical DB history trace includes oracle time and cannot substitute for this protocol

implemented_helpers.host_observation: preflight.py: CPU/RAM only; no exclusive controlled host or IO/thermal validation
implemented_helpers.stationarity: statistics_checks.py: three-window median guard, unit tested; not integrated into a confirmatory campaign
implemented_helpers.uncertainty: statistics_checks.py: exact binomial order-statistic bounds and paired block bootstrap, unit tested; not applied to new performance data
